notes.title: Patch #7 (Cut The Fluff!) - Version 1.0.7
notes.notes:
After looking at a majority of feedback I've done a few changes to make the game and experience much nicer. 
A lot of feedback was that, it was annoying to try get all the endings due to doing the same thing over and over again. 
So here is what has been done to remedy this. 

[i][u]The main 3 endings are ending 1-3[/u][/i]

[b]When you don't have any of the main 3 endings[/b] - The first time you play the game it will be a standard playthrough. However, the notes will not appear.

[b]When you have 1 of the main 3 endings[/b] - The second time you play it will play much like the first time but there is a much lower delay between events. This will make sure things happen much quicker.
The notes will now start appearing also.

[b]When you have 2 of the main 3 endings[/b] - The game will run more like the demo version of the game, cutting most of the content and keeping a fast pace. 

[b]When you have all main 3 endings[/b] - Once you have all main 3 endings and have played ending 4, the game will randomize between the 'Normal' shift and the 'Demo Like' shift.

[b]Additional Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed - Secret Ending still happening during ending 5 if both triggered.
[*]Fixed - Door speed after Ghost Hand scene.
[*]Fixed - When speed of events happen.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #5 - Version 1.0.5
notes.notes:
There hasn't been any major fixes on this patch. 

One major change however, is that the time of waiting for a next event to happen has been reduced. This means you'll have less waiting time for the next event to happen.
Over time the game will get quicker as the main game progresses.

notes.title: Security Booth - Director's Cut is NOW AVAILABLE!!!
notes.notes:
You can now get the game!
I hope you all enjoy it!
[previewyoutube=TsyvQVb6QGY;full][/previewyoutube]
The Director's Cut Edition of Security Booth comes with many new features and changes from the original version.

[b][u]Randomized Cars[/u][/b]
Cars will now be randomized, this means each play-though will be different. However, key events will still happen the same way.

[b][u]Widescreen Mode[/u][/b]
Aspect ratio is unlocked, no more black side bars!

[b][u]New Endings[/u][/b]
Security Booth: Director's Cut has a total of 7 endings.

[u][b]Nexus Archives Tapes[/b][/u]
There are 3 tapes that are extra content which extra story/lore. To view them you will need to unlock the first 3 main endings.

[b][u]Compatible With Controller[/u][/b]
You asked for it! You can now use a controller to play Security Booth: Director's Cut.

notes.title: Rename from Revamp to Director's Cut!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

A quick update about the name change.

I've now renamed the game from[b] Security Booth Revamp[/b] to [b]Security Booth: Director's Cut[/b] - which fits way more with the theme of the game and it's tie ins with the VHS ascetic and the director in Nova Nexus. 

I'm really looking forward to showing what else I got in store, it's slow progress as I do this around my full-time job but I'm looking forward to having everyone play it at some point this year.
